run_kernel_analyzer: run the kernel analyzer CLI on Python files to detect issues with verbose logging enabled
review_kernel_issues: review Python files for kernel analyzer issues and output results in console format
test_kernel_analyzer_github: test the kernel analyzer on Python files and output results in GitHub Actions format
analyze_kernel_types: analyze Python files against mujoco_warp types.py to detect kernel compatibility issues
run_kernel_analyzer_multi: run the kernel analyzer on multiple Python files with custom types path
